description: Defines the GrainInterfaceType struct, interfaces, and attributes related to identifying and managing grain interface types in Orleans.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceType
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a unique identifier for a grain interface, with methods for comparison, string conversion, and creation.

classes.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider
classes.description: An interface for retrieving a GrainInterfaceType for a given Type.

classes.name: AttributeGrainInterfaceTypeProvider
classes.description: A class implementing IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider that retrieves GrainInterfaceType based on attributes applied to types.

classes.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProviderAttribute
classes.description: An attribute interface for specifying the GrainInterfaceType associated with a particular interface.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeAttribute
classes.description: An attribute applying a specific GrainInterfaceType to an interface, implementing IGrainInterfaceTypeProviderAttribute.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a GrainInterfaceType from a string value.

methods.name: TryGetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a GrainInterfaceType for a given Type, outputting the result.

methods.name: GetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the GrainInterfaceType associated with the attribute's type.
